description: Visual target present in LEFT visual hemifield (coarse)
encoding: Poisson drive at rate proportional to target salience onto LEFT-eye members of the entry populations (hemisphere = hemifield at this stage)
notes: Refinement path: use column_assignment x/y to stimulate only columns covering the target's screen position.

description: Visual target present in RIGHT visual hemifield (coarse)
encoding: same as vis_target_left but RIGHT-eye members
Poisson drive whose rate scales with simulated angular expansion velocity
differential drive of HS vs VS populations signed by flow direction

description: Directional motion in the visual field (object movement)
encoding: subtype-selective drive: T4a-d/T5a-d subtypes correspond to four directional preferences; drive the subtype matching the CV-measured motion vector
notes: Direction->subtype assignment needs a calibration experiment before use.

encoding: L1 (ON) vs L2 (OFF) drive ratio encodes luminance change; L3 baseline encodes ambient level

description: Discrete approaching object (non-looming, e.g. NPC walking toward player)
encoding: LC16/LC17 drive scaled by object size/approach speed; fallback to LPLC2 for fast expansions

description: Game reward event (EXP gain, level-up, item, quest complete)
encoding: brief Poisson burst onto a PAM reward subset (biological analog: sugar-reward DAN activation)
notes: ENGINEERED: game events are not sugar; the mapping is an analogy that must stay labeled.

description: Game punishment event (damage taken, death, fall)
encoding: brief Poisson burst onto a PPL1 punishment subset (biological analog: shock/bitter DAN activation)
